```python
import FreeCAD
import PartDesign
import Part

# Define the parameters
inner_diameter = 10.0  # mm
overall_height = 15.0  # mm
flange_diameter = 22.0  # mm
flange_thickness = 4.0  # mm
hex_nut_width_across_flats = 16.0  # mm
hex_nut_width_across_corners = hex_nut_width_across_flats / (2 * 3.141592653589793 / 6)  # mm
hex_nut_half_angle = 30.0  # degrees

# Create a new document
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("HexFlangeNut")

# Create a PartDesign body
body = PartDesign.Body(doc)

# Create a hexagonal nut body
hex_nut_body = PartDesign.Feature(body)
hex_nut_body.Shape = Part.makeHexagonalPrism(hex_nut_width_across_flats, hex_nut_half_angle, overall_height)

# Create a circular flange
flange_body = PartDesign.Feature(body)
flange_body.Shape = Part.makeCylinder(flange_diameter / 2, overall_height, FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0, overall_height / 2))

# Create a plain through hole
through_hole_body = PartDesign.Feature(body)
through_hole_body.Shape = Part.makeCylinder(inner_diameter / 2, overall_height, FreeCAD.Vector(0, 0, overall_height / 2))

# Create a union of the hex nut body and the flange body
union_body = PartDesign.Feature(body)
union_body.Shape = hex_nut_body.Shape.fuse(flange_body.Shape)

# Create a difference between the union body and the through hole body
final_body = PartDesign.Feature(body)
final_body.Shape = union_body.Shape.cut(through_hole_body.Shape)

# Set the final body as the active body
body.setActiveBody(final_body)

# Save the document
doc.saveAs(__file__.replace('.py', '.FCStd'))
```
